description: Service header: the real-time board's U0TXD, U0RXD and GND
notes: THREE PINS: 1 TXD (IO43, out, through R-TXD-SER), 2 RXD (IO44, in), 3 GND. PROGRAMMING AND RECOVERY ARE OVER THE MATRIX'S OWN USB-C ONLY (owner, 2026-10-03: 'Program over USB only'; ADR 0021 amendment 2026-10-03): its USB-Serial-JTAG through the tail USB-C, and with the lid off its own BOOT and RESET buttons force download mode - so EN and IO0 are not wired out and this header is a UART and its ground. PART: hanxia HX PZ2.54-1x3P ZZ, LCSC C32713269, 2.5 insulator, 3 mm tail, 6 mm post, gold [ds connectors/HANXIA-HX-PZ2.54-1x3P-ZZ.pdf]; the 1x5's family (it replaces C32713271). Assembly: hand

description: Series resistor on U0TXD (IO43) to HDR-SERVICE pin 1
notes: AT J-MCU PIN 22, the first part on IO43 after the ribbon, then on to HDR-SERVICE pin 1. Espressif's value: 'It is recommended to connect a 499 Ohm series resistor to the U0TXD line to suppress harmonics' [ds datasheets/logic/ESP-HARDWARE-DESIGN-GUIDELINES-ESP32S3.pdf p.16]; it also limits the current a strike on the header pin can push into IO43. UNI-ROYAL 0805W8F4990T5E, LCSC C17722 (JLC extended)
